title: kraft cloud instance create
description: Create an instance on Unikraft Cloud from an image.

certificate.description: Set the certificates to use for the service

domain.description: The domain names to use for the service

entrypoint.description: Set the entrypoint for the instance

memory.description: Specify the amount of memory to allocate (MiB increments)

name.description: Specify the name of the instance

output.description: Set output format. Options: table, yaml, json, list

port.description: Specify the port mapping between external to internal

replicas.description: Number of replicas of the instance

restart.description: Set the restart policy for the instance (default 'never')

rollout.description: Set the rollout strategy for an instance

rollout-qualifier.description: Set the rollout qualifier used for t...

rollout-wait.description: Time to wait before performing rollout action (default '10s')

scale-to-zero.description: Scale to zero policy of the instance (default 'off')

scale-to-zero-cooldown.description: Cooldown period before scaling to zero

scale-to-zero-stateful.description: Save state when scaling to zero

service.description: Attach this instance to an existing service

start.description: Immediately start the instance after creation

subdomain.description: Set the subdomains to use when creating the service

vcpus.description: Specify the number of vCPUs to allocate

volume.description: List of volumes to attach instance to

wait-for-image.description: Wait for the image to be available before creating the instance

wait-for-image-timeout.description: Time to wait before timing out when waiting for image (default '1m0s')
